name: Objurgation
description: Below %hp_threshold:pct%% health, any blow this unit takes is met first with a barrier, burning %int_consumed:pct%% of its intelligence into %int_to_hp% health of shielding per point.
details: The barrier goes up just before the damage lands, and lasts %barrier_duration% turns.
Can only trigger once every %cooldown% turns.

upgrade.summary: A killing blow instead burns every point of intelligence into health.
details: The barrier goes up just before the damage lands, and lasts %barrier_duration% turns.
A blow that would actually kill this unit is answered differently: it burns %fatal_int_consumed:pct%% of its intelligence and heals %int_to_hp% health per point, cheating death outright.
Can only trigger once every %cooldown% turns, whichever of the two fires.
